title: Wave speed values
description: Essential: The response must state at least one correct wave speed (8 m/s, 4 m/s, or 8/3 m/s).

title: Time for B's peak
description: Essential: The response must state at least one correct time for B to first reach a peak (0.05 s or 0.15 s).

title: Period from graph
description: Important: The student correctly extracts the wave period (T = 0.2 s) from the provided vibration graph.

title: Wavelength determination
description: Important: The student correctly relates the distance d and the condition 'one trough between A and B' to find possible wavelengths (e.g., d = λ/2, λ, 3λ/2).

title: Phase relationship analysis
description: Important: The student considers whether particles A and B are in phase or out of phase to determine the correct time for B to reach a crest.

title: Wave speed calculation
description: Important: The student correctly applies the formula v = λ / T for each determined wavelength.

title: Multiple scenario recognition
description: Optional: The student identifies that the 'one trough between' condition leads to multiple possible wavelengths and thus multiple answers.

title: Incorrect phase assumption
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student assumes only one specific phase relationship (in-phase or out-of-phase) without considering the other, leading to missing a valid time answer.

title: Wavelength misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly interprets 'one trough between A and B' (e.g., assumes d = λ, ignoring other harmonic possibilities).
